translations.web: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
translations.bsb: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
translations.kjv: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
translations.asv: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.
